text: 在WAIC 2026静安专场活动上，鹿明机器人与三菱电机自动化（中国）有限公司发布工业装配场景合作案例。双方将围绕工业装配开展联合研发，推动具身智能机器人提升任务理解、环境适配和自主学习能力。
text_en: At the WAIC 2026 Jing'an special event, LumiRobotics and Mitsubishi Electric Automation (China) Ltd. released a collaboration case in industrial assembly scenarios. The two parties will conduct joint R&D around industrial assembly to enhance embodied intelligent robots' capabilities in task understanding, environmental adaptation, and autonomous learning.
